# #388 — QMD-3: Report qmd index freshness in operator-doctor so staleness alarms instead of passing silently

## Problem

The qmd index went 39 days stale with the most active repository absent
entirely, and nothing surfaced it. A stale index still returns results — just
old ones — so the failure mode is silent by construction.

`src/operator-doctor.ts` already exists and already references qmd. It is the
natural place for this check.

## Scope

- Add a qmd freshness check to operator-doctor reporting: last index update
  timestamp, per-collection age, total collections, embedded vector count.
- Warn past a threshold (proposed: 48h since last update).
- Flag collections that exist on disk under the Development root but are not
  registered, so a missing repo is visible without a manual `comm` diff.

## Why this is load-bearing

qmd feeds `search-all`, `repo-facts`, and the context-pack repo-facts sections.
When the index is stale, those surfaces are confidently wrong rather than
empty — which is worse than being unavailable, because nothing signals doubt.

## Verification

- Doctor reports a stale index when one exists.
- Doctor reports a Development directory that is not a registered collection.
- Doctor passes clean after #386 and #402 land.
